FN-KHHX755-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 387
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/06/2025
House Bill 387 as introduced could decrease sales and use tax receipts to local governments by
an undetermined amount, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, dependent on any county and
municipal governing bodies that reduces its sales and use tax on food, regardless of any growth
in the respective general fund of the local government, as provided by this bill, that otherwise
could not reduce its sales and use tax on food under current law.

Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/28/2025

receipts to local governments by an undetermined amount, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026,
dependent on any county and municipal governing bodies that reduces its sales and use tax on
food, regardless of any growth in the respective general fund of the local government, as
provided by this bill, that otherwise could not reduce its sales and use tax on food under current
law.

FN-KHHX755-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 387
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/30/2025
House Bill 387 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would
decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the following estimated amounts,
beginning in fiscal year 2026, by reducing the state sales and use tax rate on machinery from
1.5%, as set by current law, to 1.25% beginning September 1, 2025.
Fund Estimated Annual Loss
Education Trust Fund $11.3 million
State General Fund $4.3 million
Total $15.6 million
